name: mermaid-validate
description: Validates the jdbranham-diagram-panel mermaid content in dashboards/*.json against the EXACT mermaid version that plugin bundles (8.8.0 - confirmed from the published plugin .zip, not npm's current ^8.8.0 resolution). Run `npm install` here once, then `node validate.js` after any change to build_ha_dashboard.py's diagram content.
